'''Andrew Nelson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 9th at [[September 2000 Las Vegas tournament (23 September)]] on 23 September 2000, according to Dan Christy's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1263">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-23-las-vegas-9-23-director-viewd1263/ las-vegas-9-23-director-view], DeckTech (Dan "Mystikal" Christy, 23 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-23-las-vegas-9-23-director-viewd1263/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
